titles.native: テニスの王子様 BEST GAMES!!

description:
A reanimation of the most popular matches in the series to commemorate its 20th anniversary.

These matches include:
- Tezuka vs Atobe (Kantou Tournament)
- Eiji/Oishi vs Niou/Yagyuu (Kantou Tournament)
- Kaidou/Inui vs Choutarou/Shishido (Kantou Tournament)
- Fuji vs Kirihara (Kantou Tournament)
